This section correctly identifies the need for evluation. It however doesn't offer further practical guides nor provide a draft framework to countries on how to assess systems before deployment.
This framework is a critical step that will guide procurement teams in evaluating vendor claims and provide a basis for approving in-country AI tools for clinical decision support

public.text:
This section correctly identifies the need for evluation. It however doesn't offer further practical guides nor provide a draft framework to countries on how to assess systems before deployment.
This framework is a critical step that will guide procurement teams in evaluating vendor claims and provide a basis for approving in-country AI tools for clinical decision support
public.suggestedRevision:
1) Add a sub-section on AI evaluation and assurance, including: a tiered approach to evaluation commensurate with risk (higher scrutiny for autonomous vs assistive systems); guidance on establishing test datasets representative of local populations; requirements for performance disaggregation across population subgroups; and a protocol for ongoing monitoring of model drift. 
2) Reference existing frameworks such as WHO AI evaluation guidance and the EU AI Act conformity assessment approach.
